'''Dox Piter''' was a collection of villages in the south of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. The villages were located at the base of a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] known as [[The Dagger (Onderon)|the Dagger]]. It was at Dox Piter where a legendary conflict took place between [[Wodnakki]] and the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Guard]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Lina (Onderon)|Lina]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dox Piter is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' in the codex entry 'The Dagger at Dox Piter'.<ref name="Codex" />
